title: [AINews] Jensen Huang resigns after 33 years leading NVIDIA
author: swyx .ai
description: November 12, 2026 — Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO. What happens to open source/American AI leadership?
summary: Congrats to Gemini 4 Hydrogen on their launch and it seems Anthropic’s IPO is well under way, but today’s headline was only ever going to be about one thing, the most earthshaking leadership change in AI (after Demis/Jeff/et al at Google DeepMind). Yesterday we covered reports that NVIDIA’s board was preparing to replace Jensen Huang following an NYT report of an affair with an accused Chinese spy .
takeaways: AI Twitter Recap Gemini 4 Hydrogen: Google's Fast Gemini 4 Tier Ships Broadly Launch : Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a speed-first model positioned alongside Carbon and Argon.
Specs and pricing : The model offers four thinking levels (low, medium, high and xhigh) and a 1M context window.
Caveats from users : Runaway reasoning : One tester saw xhigh spend 131K thinking tokens and about $1.08 without answering a jersey-number image question.
